integrity: The sharp log-concavity threshold is deduced from explicit rational polynomial identities that are reproduced by a standalone exact-arithmetic checker. Same-model scientific review only; historical priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact for balanced complete multipartite graphs with five vertices per part and at least two parts. It does not determine the phase diagram for other part sizes or unequal parts. The exact coefficient formula used as a starting point is previously published.
title: Sharp log-concavity threshold for balanced multipartite graphs with five vertices per part
